title: Battle of Cepeda (1859)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Cepeda (1859)", at revision 1370436648, opens: "The Battle of Cepeda of 1859 took place on October 23 at Cañada de Cepeda, Buenos Aires Province, Argentina. The Argentine Confederation army, led by federalist Justo José de Urquiza defeated the State of Buenos Aires forces, led by unitarian Bartolomé Mitre." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q76914, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle 1859". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
